about: The heavy runs: the runs the heavy-run hook refuses in a wave run by hand until a decision of the judgment module names them, and the runs the command mc17 converge evaluate keys with the hook's own reader. Each entry carries one matcher. A matcher of kind program names the file a program word, or the script word after an interpreter, ends with, compared by its last path part with a closing .exe taken off; where lightWithName is true, a word after the file that names checks makes the run a run of one check by name, which is light. A matcher of kind subcommand names the word after a program word whose last path part is one of its programs, with a word the command must hold or must not hold. A matcher of kind tool names a tool whose every call is heavy.
